ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Read the schematic diagram of the rent-paying ability of industrial, commercial, and residential land in a certain city changing with distance. <image1> Among the “distance segments” marked on the horizontal coordinate in the figure, which distance segment is farther from the city and has the greatest possibility of being a residential area? ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure, the vertical axis is “land rent level,” and the horizontal axis is “distance from the city center area.” Below the horizontal axis, six distance segments ①②③④⑤⑥ are marked in order. There are three rent-paying ability curves for different land uses in the figure: the curve that is highest near the city center and drops very quickly represents commercial land; the relatively gentle curve that is relatively dominant in the middle distance segments represents residential land; the other curve that has fluctuations in some peripheral distance segments represents industrial land. Reasoning: To determine what land use a certain distance segment is most likely to be, one should see which type of land use has the highest rent-paying ability within that distance segment. Observing the residential rent-paying ability curve in the figure, it is relatively higher than the other land-use curves near ② and ④, so both ② and ④ are distance segments with a relatively high possibility of being residential areas. The question requires choosing the distance segment with the greatest possibility of being a residential area that is “farther from the city.” Among ② and ④, ④ is farther from the city center, so the answer is 4.

method.method_draft: 先读图像：横轴是距城市中心地区距离，横轴下方有①—⑥六个距离段；纵轴是地租水平。图中有三条付租能力曲线，其中靠近市中心最高且快速下降的是商业曲线，较平缓的虚线/中间曲线表示住宅付租能力，另一条起伏较明显、在③和⑤附近较高的曲线可视为工业付租能力。再读题干：要求在横坐标标注的距离段中，找出“距离城市较远、住宅区可能性最大”的距离段。运用规则：某距离段内哪类用地付租能力最高，哪类用地最可能占据该区位。比较住宅曲线与其他曲线的相对高度，可见住宅曲线在②和④附近相对最高；其中距离城市较远的是④，所以填4。
